title: private-deployment-acme-weekly-sync-2026-05-11
content:
Private Deployment — ACME weekly sync notes (prep + follow-ups)
Date: 2026-05-11
Owner: Evelyn Park (notes)
Attendees (expected): Evelyn Park, Jon Castillo, Priya Desai, Liam O'Connor, ACME: Maya Shah (Infra), Tom Reynolds (Security)

Goal for this sync:
- Quick status on VPC peering, on-prem hardware delivery, KMS/HSM integration, and cutover milestones.
- Surface blockers and assign clear owners + due dates.
- Prepare for canary rollout window (target: 2026-05-22)

Agenda (30 min):
1) Quick status (5m) — Evelyn
2) Network & connectivity (VPC peering, firewall rules) (8m) — Jon
3) On-prem infra & rack readiness (power, rack, k8s nodes) (7m) — Priya
4) Security & keys (KMS/HSM, certs) (6m) — Liam
5) Actions / next steps (4m) — Evelyn

Prep notes / talking points:
- VPC peering: Waiting on ACME network team to confirm CIDR exceptions for 10.120.0.0/16. Maya said she'll get a response by 5/12. If not confirmed by 5/13 we escalate to Tom.
- Firewall / IP whitelisting: Need final list of egress IPs from our side. Jon to provide single-file list (expected 5/12).
- On-prem rack: Ship ETA from partner is 5/14. Installer window booked for 5/18-5/19. Priya to confirm the installer SOW and on-site contact.
- KMS/HSM: ACME prefers customer-managed KMS; we've shared KMS integration doc. Liam to validate key rotation flow end-to-end with ACME security by 5/15. Confirm HSM cross-cert process.
- Certificate rotation: We need to generate new certs for the private control plane. Action: Evelyn to create cert rotation checklist and share with ACME by 5/13.
- Bastion / jump host: ACME requested hardened bastion. We should propose our standard bastion AMI + hardening steps and confirm SSH key delivery mechanism. Jon to draft proposal by 5/14.
- Monitoring: Ensure observability is enabled in private deployment (Prometheus + Grafana access for ACME). Add retention expectations (14 days by default).

Current milestones (high level):
- Network sign-off (blocker) — target 2026-05-13
- Hardware on-site & installer run — 2026-05-19
- Private control plane deploy (staging) — 2026-05-20
- Canary customer traffic (limited) — 2026-05-22

Blockers / risks (explicit):
- Network CIDR exceptions not approved (owner: Maya at ACME) -> risk to installer window. Escalation plan: Tom (ACME security) + Redwood infra lead.
- HSM access provisioning delays: ACME security needs internal approval for HSM keys (owner: Tom). Could delay full prod cutover.
- Rack power / PDU misconfig: vendor reports "typical" but need confirmation of redundant power feed. Priya to verify with vendor contact.
- IP allowlist mismatch: if we miss an IP, peering tests will fail and push cutover. Mitigation: add testing window pre-installer.

Action items (owner — due):
- Jon Castillo — Produce consolidated egress/ingress IP list (single CSV) and firewall rule draft for ACME (due 2026-05-12).
- Priya Desai — Confirm rack install SOW, on-site contact, and redundant power feeds with vendor; share installer runbook (due 2026-05-13).
- Liam O'Connor — Run key rotation walkthrough with ACME security and validate HSM cross-cert steps; confirm if additional attestations are needed (due 2026-05-15).
- Evelyn Park — Create cert rotation checklist + staged rollout plan (staging -> canary -> prod), share with ACME and SRE (due 2026-05-13).
- Maya Shah (ACME) — Confirm CIDR exception approval or alternatives (due 2026-05-12).
- Tom Reynolds (ACME) — Provide KMS/HSM access timeline & security approval path (due 2026-05-14).
- Team (Jon + Priya) — Schedule pre-installer connectivity test window (target 2026-05-17) and invite ACME NOC (due 2026-05-13).

Decisions to call in meeting (if not resolved before):
- If CIDR exception not approved by 5/13 -> propose temporary VPN tunnel as fallback for installer window. Need decision + owner to set up (approx 4 hours of infra time).
- Whether to run initial canary with reduced model capacity (50%) to reduce risk to ACME services. Recommend yes.

Notes to self / TODOs (scratch):
- Bring the SSH bastion AMI id and hardening doc link to the call.
- Validate Monitoring dashboard access flow for ACME SREs (service account + read-only role).
- Update confluence page with installer runbook link after Priya confirms.

Follow-ups after sync (expected):
- Short summary email to ACME + internal (Evelyn) with action items and owners.
- Update confluence and attach IP list + installer runbook.
- Schedule a 30-min dry-run connectivity test on 5/17.

Next meeting: 2026-05-18 (tentative) — final pre-installer check-in

Quick references:
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/ACME/Private+Deployment
- Installer runbook (WIP): docs/link-to-runbook (will replace when Priya confirms)
- KMS integration doc: https://docs.redwood.com/kms-integration-ACME
- JIRA: JIRA-ACME-452 (networking)

Informal notes / tone: keep this as a prep scratchpad — bullets, shorthand, and unresolved questions okay. Update during/after meeting and then publish a cleaner follow-up to ACME.
